Distribution and ecology Subspecies from western Madagascar, occurring in the Boeny, Melaky and Betsiboka Regions, and present in a number of protected areas, including the Tsingy de Bemaraha National Parc, occurring mainly on limestone at altitudes below 500 m. It is also found on acidic soils up to an altitude of 1000 m in the north of the Tampoketsa Region. It is encountered in the understory of dense dry forests, on rocks, and also near rivers.
